Brand Introduction:
At Pawtique, we believe in nurturing every paw to bring joy and comfort into every pet’s life. Our carefully curated selection of pet supplies reflects our dedication to quality, ensuring that your furry friends receive only the best.

Product Description:
Discover our wide range of pet supplies, from grooming essentials to stylish accessories. Each product is designed with your pet's comfort in mind, combining functionality with fun. Whether you're looking for cozy beds, durable toys, or premium grooming tools, we have everything to keep your pet happy and healthy.

USP (Unique Selling Point):
Our pet supplies are crafted from high-quality materials, ensuring longevity and safety for your pets. We offer a variety of unique and exclusive items that cater to all your pet’s needs, making Pawtique your one-stop-shop for pet care.

Payment Terms:
We accept multiple payment methods, including major credit cards, PayPal, and more, to make your shopping experience as seamless as possible.

Other Information:
Enjoy free shipping on all orders over $50, along with easy returns and exchanges. Join our Pawtique community to receive special discounts and updates on new arrivals.

Terms & Conditions

1. Introduction

  • Welcome to the Pawtique Affiliate Program. By joining, you agree to abide by the following terms and conditions.

2. Eligibility

  • Participation in the Pawtique Affiliate Program is open to individuals who are at least 18 years old and have a valid PayPal account.

3. Enrollment

  • To enroll in the program, you must complete the registration process. All information provided must be accurate and up-to-date.

4. Affiliate Responsibilities

  • As an affiliate, you agree to promote Pawtique products using ethical and lawful marketing practices. Misrepresentation or misleading promotions are strictly prohibited.

5. Commissions

  • You will earn commissions based on the agreed percentage of sales generated through your unique affiliate link. Commissions are calculated after discounts, returns, and taxes.

6. Payment Terms

  • Commissions will be paid out monthly via PayPal, provided that your balance meets the minimum payout threshold of $50. If this threshold is not met, earnings will roll over to the next month.

7. Cookie Duration

  • Our affiliate tracking cookies last for 30 days. You will receive credit for any purchases made within this period through your affiliate link.

8. Termination

  • Pawtique reserves the right to terminate your participation in the affiliate program at any time for any reason, including but not limited to violation of these terms.

9. Modification of Terms

  • Pawtique may modify these terms at any time. Continued participation in the program following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.

10. Governing Law

  • These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, United States.
